provenance_note: Compiled from retained project runtime/test summaries and supplied configuration validation. Results and necessary measurement conditions only; no raw events, identities, commit hashes, or operational configuration.

conditions: Historical mainnet order observations pooled across multiple runtime sessions.

limitations: This is a retained historical aggregate, not a fresh benchmark of the latest code.

records.measurement_boundary: Signal receipt on the local host to the recorded order-submission timestamp; excludes upstream delivery, physical socket-send verification, exchange acknowledgement and fills.

Offered new-order signals from two simulated sources; dispatch matching means the simulator received the corresponding first order request, not an acknowledgement or fill.
conditions: Two simulated sources with distinct instruments; ten seeded runs.
Three five-second bursts per run, with five-second gaps.
The latency range is the minimum and maximum of the ten per-run p99s, not a pooled percentile.
Latency starts at simulated signal broadcast after modeled push delay and ends at simulator receipt of the matching order request.
limitations: Historical simulator acceptance result, not live exchange order throughput or sustained capacity.
100% dispatch matching does not mean 100% accepted or filled orders.
Higher offered load encountered order-cap rejections and longer latency; those runs are excluded from the passed-load claim.
Different longer-window workloads did not establish complete dispatch at sustained 150 signals/s.

records.measurement_boundary: Total normalized unique followed targets in one configuration, including the primary target.
conditions: Verified against the supplied configuration validation.
limitations: Configuration ceiling only; not a measured eight-target full-load capacity or system saturation point.

records.measurement_boundary: Configured targets in a mainnet-data rehearsal with simulated follower-side execution.
conditions: One recorded five-target rehearsal using live source data and simulated follower execution.
limitations: Not all sources were simultaneously active at full load.
This is not a five-target live execution benchmark or a sustained-load test.

records.measurement_boundary: Sources followed within one recorded mainnet execution session.
conditions: Historical small-account mainnet run reported in the project's retained aggregate summary.
limitations: Only the aggregate summary is retained here; raw session evidence is not distributed.
Not a maximum-capacity measurement, long-run availability guarantee, or independent verification of every per-source setting.

records.measurement_boundary: Source order becomes effective to follower order becomes effective, using exchange timestamps at both endpoints.
conditions: Script-controlled source, one followed target, small-account mainnet test.
Measured in one roughly five-minute test round.
limitations: Historical limited sample; no end-to-end p99 is retained.
Order effectiveness is not proof of a fill.

records.measurement_boundary: Source cancellation becomes effective to follower cancellation becomes effective, using exchange timestamps at both endpoints.
conditions: Same scripted-source mainnet round as the order-effectiveness summary, with a separate cancellation sample.
limitations: Historical limited sample; no end-to-end p99 is retained.
The cancellation sample count differs from the placement sample count.
